title: Female Indwelling Urinary Catheterization OSCE — 20 scored criteria
language: English with source-faithful Traditional Chinese criterion text
scope_note: The source PDF contains 20 scored criteria worth two points each and one additional teacher-note section. The teacher-note section is represented as critical rules, not as a twenty-first scored criterion. The XLSX reports confirm the 40-point maximum and which criteria permit partial credit.
interpretation_note: The PDF names the legal score levels but does not provide detailed operational definitions for partial credit. The criterion-level score-1 rules below conservatively decompose only the requirements explicitly named in each source criterion. They should be clinically reviewed before deployment.

xlsx_reference_mapping.completed_record_rule: Column E contains a date/time rather than 'In Progress'.

score_scale.0: Direct evidence shows that the criterion was omitted, performed incorrectly, or failed the criterion-specific requirements.
score_scale.1: Direct evidence shows a partially correct performance. This score is legal only for criteria 5, 6, 8, 13, 14, 17, 19, and 20.
score_scale.2: Direct evidence shows that the criterion was performed completely and correctly.
score_scale.null: The available visual or audio evidence is insufficient for a defensible score. Lack of visibility is not evidence of incorrect performance.

assessment_policy.missing_evidence_policy: Return unverifiable with score null. Do not convert missing, occluded, inaudible, or off-camera evidence into score 0.
assessment_policy.negative_evidence_policy: Score an omitted action as 0 only when the relevant time interval is covered sufficiently to establish that the action did not occur.
assessment_policy.partial_credit_policy: Use score 1 only when direct evidence establishes that some named requirements were satisfied and other named requirements were omitted or incorrect. Uncertainty alone never justifies score 1.
assessment_policy.binary_item_policy: Criteria whose allowed_scores are [0, 2] must never receive score 1.
assessment_policy.critical_rule_confirmation: A critical deduction requires direct continuous evidence and human confirmation; otherwise flag it for review without applying the deduction.

score_calculation.raw_score: Sum the 20 criterion scores after excluding unverifiable criteria. A complete official raw score requires all 20 criteria to be resolved.
score_calculation.score_range_when_unverifiable: Lower bound treats unresolved criteria as 0; upper bound treats each unresolved criterion as its maximum legal score of 2.
score_calculation.final_score: If the 40-point deduction is confirmed, final_score = max(0, raw_score - 40). Otherwise final_score = raw_score.

hard_dependencies: Establish the sterile field before placing or manipulating sterile equipment.
Test the urinary catheter before inserting it.
Expose and continuously stabilize the urethral meatus before and during cleansing and insertion.
Perform povidone-iodine cleansing before distilled-water cleansing.
Inflate the retention balloon only after catheter insertion.
Connect and secure the drainage system after catheter insertion.
sequence_constraints.concurrent_requirement: Criterion 15 is an instruction delivered during catheter insertion and must be evaluated with synchronized audio and video.
sequence_constraints.global_scoring_note: Do not fail criterion 20 for a harmless reordering by itself. Penalize clear disruptions of sterile, safety, or procedural dependencies.

critical_rules.description: Document every directly observed contamination event and link it to the affected criterion and timestamp.
critical_rules.reason: The PDF asks the teacher to document contamination but does not assign a fixed numerical deduction to this line.
critical_rules.assessment_action: Add a safety concern and score the affected criterion using its own scoring rules. Do not invent an additional point deduction.

critical_rules.source_text_zh: 沒有全程以一手撥開陰唇，露出尿道口，固定勿動（會扣40分）
critical_rules.description: Once one hand separates the labia and exposes the urethral meatus, that hand must remain fixed throughout the relevant cleansing and insertion interval.
critical_rules.do_not_trigger_when: The hand is occluded, the interval is missing, or continuity cannot be verified. In those cases return a critical-review flag rather than applying the deduction.

steps.source_text_zh: 適當覆蓋注意病人保暖
steps.description: Appropriately cover the patient and maintain patient warmth.
observable_evidence: The candidate places or adjusts a cover over the patient.
The patient's body is appropriately covered for warmth while preserving access needed for the procedure.

scoring_rules.2: Direct visual evidence shows appropriate covering with attention to warmth.
scoring_rules.0: Direct visual evidence shows that appropriate covering or warmth protection was not performed.

steps.source_text_zh: 維持正確和舒適的仰臥姿勢
steps.description: Maintain a correct and comfortable supine position.
observable_evidence: The patient or manikin is positioned supine.
The position is maintained in a manner consistent with comfort and procedural access.

scoring_rules.2: The supine position is directly visible and is maintained correctly and comfortably.
scoring_rules.0: The visible position is incorrect or is not maintained appropriately.

steps.source_text_zh: 打開蓄尿袋外包裝
steps.description: Open the outer package of the urinary drainage bag correctly.
observable_evidence: The drainage-bag package is identifiable before opening.
The candidate opens the outer package without a directly observed incorrect action.

scoring_rules.2: The outer package is visibly opened correctly.
scoring_rules.0: The package is visibly opened incorrectly or the action is demonstrably omitted.

steps.source_text_zh: 以無菌技術打開導尿包
steps.description: Open the catheterization kit using sterile technique.
observable_evidence: The candidate opens the catheterization kit while preserving the sterile field.
No direct contact between nonsterile hands or surfaces and the sterile contents is observed.

scoring_rules.2: The kit is opened with directly supported sterile technique.
scoring_rules.0: The opening technique is visibly incorrect, contaminates the sterile contents, or is demonstrably omitted.

steps.source_text_zh: 無菌倒水溶性優碘(手握標籤，另一隻手將蓋子朝下)
steps.description: Pour water-soluble povidone-iodine aseptically while holding the bottle at the label and keeping the cap facing downward in the other hand.
observable_evidence: The bottle is held at the label area.
The cap is retained in the other hand with its inner surface facing downward.
Povidone-iodine is poured into the sterile area without directly observed contamination.

scoring_rules.2: All named handling and aseptic-pouring requirements are directly supported.
scoring_rules.1: The pour is attempted and direct evidence shows that some, but not all, named handling requirements are correct.
scoring_rules.0: The action is omitted, clearly incorrect overall, or directly contaminates the sterile setup.

steps.source_text_zh: 消毒蒸餾水瓶口並以無菌技術倒入
steps.description: Disinfect the opening of the distilled-water bottle and pour the water using sterile technique.
observable_evidence: The bottle opening is visibly disinfected.
Distilled water is poured into the sterile area using sterile technique.

scoring_rules.2: Both opening disinfection and sterile pouring are directly supported.
scoring_rules.1: Direct evidence supports only one of the two named components or shows a partially correct execution.
scoring_rules.0: Both components are omitted or clearly incorrect, or direct contamination invalidates the action.

steps.source_text_zh: 以無菌方式將導尿管和10cc空針丟入無菌區內
steps.description: Place both the urinary catheter and the 10 mL syringe into the sterile field using sterile technique.
observable_evidence: Both the catheter and 10 mL syringe are introduced into the sterile field.
Their placement does not visibly contaminate the sterile field or equipment.

scoring_rules.2: Both objects are visibly placed into the sterile field using sterile technique.
scoring_rules.0: Either required object is omitted, placed incorrectly, or visibly contaminated during placement.

steps.source_text_zh: 戴無菌手套
steps.description: Don sterile gloves using correct sterile technique.
observable_evidence: The complete glove-donning sequence is visible.
The candidate avoids directly observed contact that contaminates sterile glove surfaces.

scoring_rules.2: Sterile gloves are donned correctly with no directly observed break in technique.
scoring_rules.1: Glove donning is directly observed to be only partially correct, without enough support for a fully correct score.
scoring_rules.0: The action is omitted, clearly incorrect, or directly contaminates the gloves.

steps.source_text_zh: 空針抽蒸餾水並測試導尿管
steps.description: Draw distilled water into the syringe and test the urinary catheter.
observable_evidence: Distilled water is drawn into the syringe.
The syringe is used to test the catheter before patient insertion.

scoring_rules.2: Both drawing distilled water and testing the catheter are directly supported.
scoring_rules.0: Either required component is demonstrably omitted or performed incorrectly.

steps.source_text_zh: 以無菌技術鋪上洞巾，露出會陰部
steps.description: Place the fenestrated drape using sterile technique and expose the perineal area through the opening.
observable_evidence: The fenestrated drape is placed without a directly observed break in sterile technique.
The perineal area is positioned within the drape opening.

scoring_rules.2: Both sterile placement and correct exposure are directly supported.
scoring_rules.0: The drape is omitted, visibly contaminated, or positioned incorrectly.

steps.source_text_zh: 以無菌技術用紗布在導尿管塗Jelly約10公分，置於無菌區內
steps.description: Using gauze and sterile technique, apply jelly to approximately 10 cm of the urinary catheter and place it in the sterile field.
observable_evidence: Jelly is applied to the catheter using gauze.
The lubricated length is approximately 10 cm when visually verifiable.
The catheter is returned to the sterile field without directly observed contamination.

scoring_rules.2: The named lubrication and sterile-placement requirements are directly supported.
scoring_rules.0: A required component is demonstrably omitted or incorrect, or the catheter is visibly contaminated.

steps.source_text_zh: 以一手撥開陰唇，露出尿道口，固定勿動
steps.description: Use one hand to separate the labia, expose the urethral meatus, and keep that hand fixed.
observable_evidence: One hand separates the labia sufficiently to expose the urethral meatus.
The same hand remains fixed during the relevant cleansing and insertion interval.

scoring_rules.2: Separation, exposure, and continuous fixed-hand stabilization are directly supported.
scoring_rules.0: A named requirement is directly observed to fail, including release or repositioning that violates the fixed-hand requirement.

steps.source_text_zh:
另一手以水溶性優碘棉棒，由上往下消毒。
(1)第一枝擦遠側小陰唇
(2)第二枝擦近側小陰唇
(3)第三枝擦中間尿道
steps.description: With the other hand, cleanse from top to bottom using povidone-iodine swabs in this order: first the far labium minus, second the near labium minus, and third the central urethral area.
observable_evidence: Three swabbing passes are distinguishable.
Each pass moves from top to bottom.
The visible order is far labium minus, near labium minus, then central urethral area.

scoring_rules.2: All three sites, top-to-bottom direction, and required order are directly supported.
scoring_rules.1: Cleansing is performed and direct evidence supports only part of the required sites, direction, or order.
scoring_rules.0: The cleansing is omitted, clearly incorrect overall, or violates the required sequence and technique substantially.

steps.source_text_zh:
以蒸餾水棉棒，由上往下擦除優碘顏色
(1)第一枝擦遠側小陰唇
(2)第二枝擦近側小陰唇
(3)第三枝擦中間尿道
steps.description: Using distilled-water swabs, wipe from top to bottom to remove the povidone-iodine color in this order: first the far labium minus, second the near labium minus, and third the central urethral area.
observable_evidence: Three wiping passes are distinguishable after povidone-iodine cleansing.
Each pass moves from top to bottom.
The visible order is far labium minus, near labium minus, then central urethral area.

scoring_rules.2: All three sites, top-to-bottom direction, required order, and post-iodine timing are directly supported.
scoring_rules.1: Wiping is performed and direct evidence supports only part of the required sites, direction, or order.
scoring_rules.0: The action is omitted, clearly incorrect overall, or substantially violates the required sequence and technique.

steps.source_text_zh: 插入導尿管時教導病人張口哈氣放鬆腹肌
steps.description: During catheter insertion, instruct the patient to open the mouth and exhale to relax the abdominal muscles.
observable_evidence: Synchronized video places the instruction during catheter insertion.
Audio or a verified transcript directly supports an instruction to open the mouth and exhale for abdominal relaxation.

scoring_rules.2: The required instruction and its timing during insertion are directly supported by synchronized evidence.
scoring_rules.0: The complete relevant interval is audible and visible, and the instruction is demonstrably omitted or incorrect.

steps.do_not_infer: Visible mouth movement, candidate posture, or generic speech without intelligible content is insufficient for score 2.

steps.source_text_zh: 插入尿管
steps.description: Insert the urinary catheter correctly.
observable_evidence: The catheter is identifiable immediately before insertion.
The insertion action and target are sufficiently visible to distinguish correct insertion from nearby manipulation.

scoring_rules.2: Correct catheter insertion is directly supported.
scoring_rules.0: Insertion is demonstrably omitted or performed incorrectly.

steps.source_text_zh: 空針打水球8-10cc (手一定要固定在尿道口避免尿管滑出)
steps.description: Inflate the catheter balloon with 8–10 mL while keeping a hand fixed at the urethral opening to prevent the catheter from slipping out.
observable_evidence: The syringe is connected to the balloon inflation port after insertion.
The administered volume is directly visible or audibly confirmed as 8–10 mL.
A hand remains fixed at the urethral opening to prevent catheter slippage.

scoring_rules.2: Balloon inflation with 8–10 mL and fixed-hand stabilization are directly supported.
scoring_rules.1: Balloon inflation is attempted and direct evidence supports some, but not all, named requirements.
scoring_rules.0: The action is omitted, clearly incorrect overall, performed before insertion, or directly allows catheter slippage.

steps.source_text_zh: 接上蓄尿袋
steps.description: Connect the urinary drainage bag to the catheter correctly.
observable_evidence: The catheter and drainage-bag connector are identifiable.
A completed connection is visible after catheter insertion.

scoring_rules.2: The drainage bag is visibly connected correctly.
scoring_rules.0: The connection is demonstrably omitted or performed incorrectly.

steps.source_text_zh: 導尿管固定於大腿
steps.description: Secure the urinary catheter to the patient's thigh.
observable_evidence: Fixation material is applied to the catheter and thigh.
The final catheter position appears secured rather than merely placed on the thigh.

scoring_rules.2: The catheter is visibly secured correctly to the thigh.
scoring_rules.1: Fixation is attempted but is directly observed to be incomplete or only partially effective.
scoring_rules.0: The catheter is not fixed to the thigh or the fixation is clearly incorrect.

steps.source_text_zh: 步驟操作具邏輯性
steps.description: Perform the procedure in a logical sequence.
observable_evidence: The full timeline preserves sterile and safety dependencies.
Preparation, cleansing, insertion, balloon inflation, connection, and fixation occur in a coherent progression.
Any restarts, reversals, or out-of-order actions are evaluated for their procedural consequence rather than mere timing.

scoring_rules.2: The overall sequence is logical, with no major disruption of sterile, safety, or procedural dependencies.
scoring_rules.1: The sequence is generally workable but contains directly observed minor deviations, hesitation, or limited disorder without a major safety consequence.
scoring_rules.0: The sequence is clearly poor or contains major ordering errors that disrupt sterile, safety, or procedural logic.
